title: Phantom Equity
equation: Team Alignment = Future Upside × Role Importance × Retention Incentive
hook: Your best people want a piece of what they're helping build. You can give them that without handing out shares.
statement: Reward key people with phantom equity, a payout from a future sale, without giving away actual ownership.
explainer: Instead of shares, you promise a payout tied to a future event like a sale. They get an owner's upside without becoming owners. Do it with proper contracts and real legal advice.
sop: Pick the people who meaningfully raise the company's value.
Decide which future event triggers the payout.
Put it in writing with legal help.
Review it as the company grows.
equation_example: Future Upside 8, Role Importance 9, Retention Incentive 6. 8 × 9 × 6 = 432 Team Alignment, out of 1,000. Higher means it'll keep that person committed through the hard years. Lower means the reward won't really change what they do.
question: Name the one person who most needs to feel tied to the long-term value of your business.
closing_statement: Pay for alignment before you need loyalty.
